decision_source.attribution: Original four Kevin decisions in September 28 release instructions

additional_decision_source_note: Later dated decisions carry their own decision_source in each added record.

P15.A1.reason: readability; author's assessment of the facts.
P15.A1.evidence: P00045 runs Torrance to April 30; Cibola was asked to end April 30; a reported county-manager account instead gives Torrance March 30. The locked Methodology discloses the difference. Author chose the short wording.

P20.A1.reason: readability; author's assessment of the facts.
P20.A1.evidence: The handoff recorded author acceptance before the enacted text was registered. Official P.L. 119-98 §1(a) now verifies this short title; acceptance remains a wording decision.

P20.A2.reason: readability; author's assessment of the facts.
P20.A2.evidence: Muscatine agreement is a U.S. Marshals Service agreement with an ICE rider. The cited news reports an increased agreement cap, not verified paid amounts. Author retained wording.

P61.A1.exact_text: its three task orders. They carry $17,465,361.06
P61.A1.claim_statement: The author accepted the pronoun linking $17,465,361.06 to the preceding three-task-order sentence; the amount comes from two ICE orders, and the parent has a third DOJ order.
P61.A1.reason: readability; author's assessment of the facts.
P61.A1.evidence: Parent USAspending API lists three children. The $17,465,361.06 selected File C object-class 25.4 amount is from ICE’s two direct orders; the USMS third order has $3,335,386 in separate DOJ-funded award obligations. Author retained wording.

FN1.A1.exact_text: Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act of 2006, § 2(a)(4), 31 U.S.C. 6101 note, (https://uscode.house.gov/view.xhtml?req=granuleid:USC-prelim-title31-section6101&num=0&edition=prelim).
FN1.A1.decision_source: Kevin instruction relayed by coordinator task 01a0d96a-2d4d-7da3-bb3a-547d61e6b45a on 2026-09-28
FN1.A1.reason: Cites the section numbering of the current codified text (31 U.S.C. 6101 note, as amended by the DATA Act); §2(a)(2) is the numbering as enacted in 2006.
FN1.A1.evidence: The official 2024 U.S. Code note prints the Federal award definition at §2(a)(4), while P.L. 109-282 as enacted printed it at §2(a)(2).
FN1.A1.proposed_fix: If citing the 2006 enacted text, use §2(a)(2); retain §2(a)(4) only with the current-codified-text source layer.

P7.A1.exact_text: The inspector general concluded that ICE had “no assurance” it executed detention agreements in “the best interest of the Federal Government, taxpayers, or detainees."
P7.A1.decision_source: Kevin instruction relayed by coordinator task 01a0d96a-2d4d-7da3-bb3a-547d61e6b45a on 2026-09-28
P7.A1.reason: Paraphrase; the OIG's wording ('detention center contracts') is in the linked report.
P7.A1.evidence: OIG-18-53 printed pages 1 and 5 use detention center contracts; the published sentence says detention agreements.
P7.A1.proposed_fix: For a verbatim account of the OIG conclusion, use detention center contracts.

P15.A2.exact_text: required local governments to terminate their IGSAs.
P15.A2.decision_source: Kevin instruction relayed by coordinator task 01a0d96a-2d4d-7da3-bb3a-547d61e6b45a on 2026-09-28
P15.A2.reason: Summary of HB 9 §3; the earliest-permissible-date condition is in the linked law.
P15.A2.evidence: H.B. 9 §3(B) requires termination at the earliest permissible date under the agreement terms.
P15.A2.proposed_fix: Add the earliest-permissible-date condition for statutory precision.

P19.A1.decision_source: Kevin instruction relayed by coordinator task 01a0d96a-2d4d-7da3-bb3a-547d61e6b45a on 2026-09-28
P19.A1.reason: Summary of OIG and GAO risk findings; the reports' 'may have overpaid' wording is in the linked sources.
P19.A1.evidence: OIG-18-53 says ICE may have overpaid; the published phrase omits that uncertainty.
P19.A1.proposed_fix: Say risk of overpayment or may have overpaid.

P3.A1.exact_text: From February 2025 through July 2026, ICE obligated $5.91 billion to operate and maintain detention facilities
P3.A1.decision_source: Kevin instruction relayed by coordinator task 01a0d96a-2d4d-7da3-bb3a-547d61e6b45a on 2026-09-28
P3.A1.reason: The Methodology states that object class 25.4 is broader than detention.
P3.A1.evidence: The $5.91 billion class 25.4 amount is verified; published Methodology P28 explicitly says the class covers more than detention.
P3.A1.proposed_fix: Label the amount object class 25.4 rather than detention-only operating costs.

P31.A1.exact_text: Each File C record carries the recipient's Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).
P31.A1.decision_source: Kevin instruction relayed by coordinator task 01a0d96a-2d4d-7da3-bb3a-547d61e6b45a on 2026-09-28
P31.A1.reason: Methodology wording; the no-recipient rows are disclosed in the same section.
P31.A1.evidence: Published Methodology P32 quantifies $9,498,809 in no-recipient rows, so each is not literally true across all File C rows.
P31.A1.proposed_fix: Say linked File C records carry recipient UEIs; identify the no-recipient exception.

P48.A1.exact_text: Of that, $78,730,777 went to the three facilities ICE also listed under a federal or contract type.
P48.A1.decision_source: Kevin instruction relayed by coordinator task 01a0d96a-2d4d-7da3-bb3a-547d61e6b45a on 2026-09-28
P48.A1.reason: Methodology wording; the section's Limits paragraph says a name match is not a facility allocation.
P48.A1.evidence: Published Methodology P46 sums each matched award once and P50 says a name match does not identify the agreement; the $78,730,777 is not allocated to facilities.
P48.A1.proposed_fix: Say $78,730,777 in matched awards named three facilities rather than went to those facilities.
